outcomes.wins: every target clears and no guard loses. It feeds the next re-plan only.
outcomes.quiet: every required row and metric was read, every target had room, and J6(g) does not win (a target did not clear, or a guard lost).
outcomes.refused: One of two cases. (a) A required row is missing, doubled or not completed; a required metric is absent or did not run; a recorded value disagrees with its own counts; or an identity, data or comparability check fails. (b) A target has no room under R9_room (cannot_clear). Neither case is ever read as quiet.
